actions.reason: secp256r1/src/group.rs: the odd-multiple tables P, 3P, ..., 15P are built by a co-Z chain in which Z_k = Z_{k-1} * h_k. A new odd_multiples_co_z returns the table together with the factors h_k, or None in the degenerate cases. A new normalize_co_z_chains batch-inverts only the last Z of each table (one shared inversion) and gets the earlier inverses by multiplying with h_k. Generic batch normalization needs about two multiplications per entry, so this saves roughly two per entry. multi_scalar_mul_vartime_unchecked and the point table in double_scalar_mul_vartime_unchecked use this path. Both keep the previous odd_multiples + batch_normalize path as a fallback when any chain is degenerate. odd_multiples_co_z also inlines the doubling of P: its intermediates X*4Y^2 and 8Y^4 already are P rescaled to the Z of 2P, so one squaring and three multiplications are no longer recomputed. Affine outputs are unique, so results are byte-identical. Measured: msm_ir 0.9889, scalar_mul_ir 0.9993, decode_ir 1.0000; equivalence identical.

journal.text:
Tried speeding up msm_ir in secp256r1. First pass was in field.rs around lines 755-770, then I moved to group.rs. The idea that held: the odd-multiple tables P, 3P, ..., 15P come from a co-Z chain where Z_k = Z_{k-1} * h_k. New odd_multiples_co_z returns the table plus the h_k factors, or None in degenerate cases. New normalize_co_z_chains batch-inverts only the last Z of each table with one shared inversion and recovers earlier inverses by multiplying with h_k.

Evaluation 1, the field.rs change at 15 lines, did not help: msm_ir ratio 1.0005, rejected. Evaluation 3 reached 0.9947 and evaluation 5 reached 0.9912. Both were rejected against the required 0.9900. Evaluation 7 at 134 lines was accepted with msm_ir 157296445 to 155552933, ratio 0.9889. scalar_mul_ir came in at 0.9993 and decode_ir at 1.0000. Outputs were identical in every run.

The inversion count in table normalization was the lever. Field-level tweaks were noise. Verdict is pending replay.

Next, check whether scalar_mul can reuse normalize_co_z_chains.
